messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
Hi Rebecca, thank you for the quick reply, and for your interest in the project!

Regarding your question, it would be better if we receive them in separate files, also MP3 formate would be fine & enough.

Thank you again and looking forward to receiving & hearing the tracks!

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
Hello dear,

I truly apologize for the delay, I had an emergency and had to take a few days off. Thank you for your patience and for sending over multiple takes; I really appreciate your effort.

After reviewing them, I feel that **Take Two** is better than the others especially in terms of pauses, but we'd love to try another version that brings even more energy and liveliness to the delivery.

We actually have an AI-generated sample that I'm sharing now, just as a reference for the tone and energy we’re aiming for. Of course, your vibrant voice will bring it to life far better!

I understand there’s a time difference, but please let me know when you’re available to record today, so I’ll make sure to be online and responsive.

Best regards!

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Good morning, here at least. I hope things are ok on your end.

I will be able to work on your project in two hours or so. I have a few other quick project ahead of your. I will notify ya when I start. Sound good?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
Good morning, yes elhamdolellah all is good! thank you so much :)

And yes sounds good, goodluck in your projects and will be waiting your notification!

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Hey Laila, I am starting now. I'll keep ya posted if I have any questions.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Thanks Rebecca, I’m here for any questions

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: perfect. I just recored three takes, they are raw and not edited. Take a listen and let me know which, if any, of those three you like. First, second or third.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
Hi, thank you, I liked the first one, but i think the last sentence “without you having to wait..” has too many pauses.

Can we make it smoother, inspiring and with a little sense of pride (without over acting as well)

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Ok, smoother, inspiring, pride, energy and liveliness....heres five more. The first one is a combination of first one that ya liked with a revision of the last sentence.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: And again, these are raw files.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
Thank you Rebecca,
2nd & 3rd takes are actually two different directions, but they are really good!

Can you send both edited separately so I can send them to top managers for approval?

And i’ll proceed with the 1st payment today, but for the remaining amount, can we wait till Sunday to have the final approval for the final take?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Of course! Have a great night!

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
Hello Rebecca, thank you so much for your effort and for your quick responses.

One from the last two takes is already get approved, so we can proceed now with the remaining payment of 10$.

Thank you dear!

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Hey Laila! Happy to hear from you today.
I am so happy to hear this! Thank you for your kind words.
Have a great rest of your day

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Thank you so much Rebecca, sorry for the delayed transfer!
